items: No black flash when switching tabs on iPhone and iPad: the colour band stays and only the page fades in.
Now shows Watch Live only once a channel is found; until then, Where to Watch.
Suggested backup TV guides now list the best for live sport first.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
